proposal: Reg 5 notification: The removal and replacement of 3 no. antennas and installation of ancillary equipment. The installation of 1 no 0.3m dish, 1 no 0.6m dish and associated equipment mounted on the antennas support poles. The refreshing of equipment contained within existing equipment cabin. The new antennas will be mounted at the same location as the existing. The antennas are proposed at the same height to ensure the effective transmission of signal to the locality and will be mounted on existing support poles. This is an established telecommunications site and the amendments proposed do not seek to increase the height of the installation or move the antenna locations. It is acknowledged that the site is within the Conservation area, however, the proposed upgrade works will be minor, and the installation will be visually similar to the existing. Due to the minimal nature of changes the impact is considered to be less than substantial. The upgrading of this site therefore presents an opportunity to address a need for coverage without having to site a new base station installation in the area. The amount of telecommunications equipment on the site has been kept to a technical minimum and the smallest practical components have been utilised. It has been designed to be read in the same context as the existing equipment, so as to limit visual impact whilst still working within the technical design constraints of delivering 5G. The site is an existing telecoms site, and the development will enable the site to provide improved coverage, to the area whilst having no significant impact on the appearance of the building or the local area. Upgrading existing sites is in accordance with the Code of practice for wireless network development in England (2022) and ensures that the number of installations is kept to a minimum in accordance with Chapter 10 of the NPPF (2021).
